name: @workspace/api-mocks
//exports: Three entry points, each for a consumer that must not pay for the others. `./fixtures` is deliberately free of any msw import, so a consumer that wants a payload and not a handler loads no mocking library at all. `./node` is the one place msw/node is named, which is what keeps the environment choice out of every other file — the root entry names msw itself but never an interceptor, which is what lets the Playwright runner resolve these handlers with `answerFor` while intercepting its own way.
